name: Irinotecan (single agent)
cyclesNote: Single-agent irinotecan as a later-line option for metastatic esophageal / esophagogastric cancer when a taxane or fluoropyrimidine-platinum has already been used; continue until progression or toxicity.

institution.provenance: StewardMD ONCOTREE draft protocol authored from standard guidelines (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Antiemetic + anticholinergic
premedications.notes: Antiemetic prophylaxis; atropine available for acute cholinergic diarrhea; loperamide instructions for delayed diarrhea.

supportiveCare: Single-agent topoisomerase-I inhibitor; counsel on early (cholinergic) and delayed diarrhea and manage promptly.
Monitor for neutropenia; consider UGT1A1 status in patients with severe toxicity.

doseModificationRules.text: Hold and reduce irinotecan for severe diarrhea or neutropenia; consider UGT1A1*28 homozygosity; physician decides.

drugs.name: Irinotecan
drugs.notes: Irinotecan 180 mg/m2 IV on day 1 of a 14-day cycle as single-agent later-line therapy for metastatic esophageal / esophagogastric cancer. Manage cholinergic and delayed diarrhea; reduce for UGT1A1-related toxicity. StewardMD standard-of-care wording; physician decides and the dose engine computes the patient dose.
